server_name.title: Server Name
server_name.description: Shown in the browser and in the join list your friends will search against.

server_description.title: Server Description
server_description.description: Short browser copy that explains what kind of host this is.
server_description.default: LanGame managed 7 Days to Die server

server_website_url.title: Website URL
server_website_url.description: Optional public URL shown in the browser.

server_login_confirmation_text.title: Join Confirmation Text
server_login_confirmation_text.description: Optional rules or warning text players must confirm before they finish joining.

server_password.title: Join Password
server_password.description: Leave blank for a public room. Set this when you are sharing directly with trusted players.

max_players.title: Max Players
max_players.description: Maximum concurrent player count for this instance.

visibility.title: Browser Visibility
visibility.description: Choose whether the room is public, only bootstrap-visible to friends, or completely hidden from listing.

region.title: Region
region.description: Browser region tag used by players when filtering rooms.

language.title: Primary Language
language.description: Free-text browser language tag. Use the English language name that players expect to search for.

server_disabled_network_protocols.title: Disabled Network Protocols
server_disabled_network_protocols.description: Officially recommended for port-forwarded dedicated hosts: disable SteamNetworking and prefer direct socket transport.

server_allow_crossplay.title: Allow Crossplay
server_allow_crossplay.description: Enable the native EOS crossplay discovery path. Current 7DTD servers are only searchable and joinable through crossplay when EOS sanctions are not ignored and the player-slot count stays at the default or lower.

ignore_eos_sanctions.title: Ignore EOS Sanctions
ignore_eos_sanctions.description: Ignore EOS sanctions when deciding whether a player may join. Leave this off for normal crossplay discovery.

server_max_world_transfer_speed_kibs.title: World Transfer Cap (KiB/s)
server_max_world_transfer_speed_kibs.description: Throttle first-join world transfer rate so one fresh client does not saturate the host.

reserved_slots.title: Reserved Slots
reserved_slots.description: Player capacity reserved for users with the required permission level.

reserved_slots_permission.title: Reserved Slot Permission
reserved_slots_permission.description: Required 7DTD permission level for using reserved slots. Lower numbers are more trusted.

admin_slots.title: Admin Overflow Slots
admin_slots.description: Extra seats that admins can still use after the normal cap is full.

admin_slots_permission.title: Admin Slot Permission
admin_slots_permission.description: Required 7DTD permission level for using the admin overflow slots.

admin_users.title: Admin Users
admin_users.description: Structured native admin user entries rendered into serveradmin.xml.

platform.title: Account platform
platform.description: Platform namespace used by 7DTD for this account ID.

userid.title: Platform user ID
userid.description: The account ID recorded by 7DTD logs for the selected platform.

admin_groups.title: Admin Groups
admin_groups.description: Structured native Steam group admin entries rendered into serveradmin.xml.

whitelist_users.title: Whitelisted Users
whitelist_users.description: Structured native whitelist user entries rendered into serveradmin.xml.

platform.title: Account platform
platform.description: Platform namespace used by 7DTD for this account ID.

userid.title: Platform user ID
userid.description: The account ID recorded by 7DTD logs for the selected platform.

whitelist_groups.title: Whitelisted Groups
whitelist_groups.description: Structured native whitelist Steam group entries rendered into serveradmin.xml.

blacklist_entries.title: Blacklist Entries
blacklist_entries.description: Structured native blacklist entries rendered into serveradmin.xml.

platform.title: Account platform
platform.description: Platform namespace used by 7DTD for this account ID.

userid.title: Platform user ID
userid.description: The account ID recorded by 7DTD logs for the selected platform.

unbandate.title: Unban date
unbandate.description: Local server date or date and time in YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss format. The default is an effectively permanent ban.

command_permissions.title: Command Permissions
command_permissions.description: Structured native command permission rules rendered into serveradmin.xml.

persistent_player_profiles.title: Persistent Player Profiles
persistent_player_profiles.description: If enabled, each player is locked to the last character profile they joined with on this server.

game_world.title: World Type / Name
game_world.description: Use Navezgane for the handcrafted map, RWG for a generated world, or a custom pregen world folder name.

game_mode.title: Game Mode
game_mode.description: Current dedicated-server game mode. The supported native mode is GameModeSurvival.

world_name.title: Save Name
world_name.description: Save-game identity for this server. Changing it points the host at a different world save.

world_seed.title: World Seed
world_seed.description: Only used for RWG worlds. The handcrafted Navezgane map ignores this.

world_size.title: Generated World Size
world_size.description: Used only for RWG. The native configuration documents 6144, 8192, and 10240 as officially supported sizes.

sandbox_code.title: Sandbox Code
sandbox_code.description: Paste the code copied from the in-game Sandbox Options screen. Version 3.0 uses this code for difficulty, pacing, loot, zombie behavior, blood moon, and related sandbox rules.

build_create.title: Creative Build Mode
build_create.description: Enable creative-mode building on the server.

camera_restriction_mode.title: Camera Restriction
camera_restriction_mode.description: Controls whether players can use first person, third person, or freely switch between both camera modes.

player_killing_mode.title: Player Killing Mode
player_killing_mode.description: Controls which players may damage each other.

player_safe_zone_level.title: Spawn Safe-Zone Level
player_safe_zone_level.description: Players at or below this level create a temporary no-enemy safe zone on spawn.

player_safe_zone_hours.title: Spawn Safe-Zone Hours
player_safe_zone_hours.description: In-world hours that the beginner safe zone stays active.

bedroll_dead_zone_size.title: Bedroll Dead-Zone Size
bedroll_dead_zone_size.description: Half-size of the anti-spawn box around each active bedroll, measured in blocks.

bedroll_expiry_time.title: Bedroll Expiry (Real Days)
bedroll_expiry_time.description: Real-world days a bedroll stays active after its owner was last online.

allow_spawn_near_friend.title: Spawn Near Friend
allow_spawn_near_friend.description: Controls whether first-time players may spawn near an online friend when joining the server.

party_shared_kill_range.title: Party Shared Kill Range
party_shared_kill_range.description: Distance players must stay within to share kill XP and quest credit.

max_uncovered_map_chunks_per_player.title: Max Uncovered Map Chunks Per Player
max_uncovered_map_chunks_per_player.description: Caps how much of the in-game map each player can uncover. Higher values increase per-player map file size and can corrupt player data if pushed too far.

max_chunk_age.title: Chunk Reset Age (Days)
max_chunk_age.description: In-game days since a chunk was last visited before the server may reset it if it is not protected by a claim or nearby bedroll. Use -1 to disable age-based chunk reset.

save_data_limit.title: Save Data Limit (MB)
save_data_limit.description: Maximum disk allowance per saved game in megabytes. The server may reset saved chunks to free space when the limit is reached. Use -1 to disable the limit.

max_spawned_zombies.title: Map Zombie Cap
max_spawned_zombies.description: Total concurrent zombies allowed across the whole map. High values hit CPU hard.

max_spawned_animals.title: Map Animal Cap
max_spawned_animals.description: Total concurrent wildlife cap across the whole map.

server_max_allowed_view_distance.title: Client View Distance Cap
server_max_allowed_view_distance.description: Upper limit clients may request. High values increase memory pressure.

max_queued_mesh_layers.title: Queued Mesh Layer Cap
max_queued_mesh_layers.description: Maximum chunk mesh layers the server may queue during mesh generation. Lower values reduce memory pressure but can slow chunk generation.

land_claim_count.title: Land Claims Per Player
land_claim_count.description: Maximum number of claim blocks each player may place.

land_claim_size.title: Land Claim Size
land_claim_size.description: Protected claim size in blocks. Use odd sizes so the claim stays centered.

land_claim_dead_zone.title: Land Claim Dead Zone
land_claim_dead_zone.description: Minimum spacing between claim blocks unless players are friends.

land_claim_expiry_time.title: Land Claim Expiry (Days)
land_claim_expiry_time.description: Real-world days a player can stay offline before claims expire.

land_claim_decay_mode.title: Offline Claim Decay Mode
land_claim_decay_mode.description: Choose how claim protection decays while a player is offline.

land_claim_online_durability_modifier.title: Online Claim Durability
land_claim_online_durability_modifier.description: Block-hardness multiplier while the owner is online. 0 means infinite protection.

land_claim_offline_durability_modifier.title: Offline Claim Durability
land_claim_offline_durability_modifier.description: Block-hardness multiplier while the owner is offline. 0 means infinite protection.

land_claim_offline_delay.title: Offline Claim Delay (Minutes)
land_claim_offline_delay.description: Delay after logout before the claim transitions from online to offline hardness.

dynamic_mesh_enabled.title: Dynamic Mesh
dynamic_mesh_enabled.description: Enable dynamic mesh updates around player-built structures.

dynamic_mesh_land_claim_only.title: Dynamic Mesh In Claim Areas Only
dynamic_mesh_land_claim_only.description: Restrict dynamic mesh updates to land-claim areas only.

dynamic_mesh_land_claim_buffer.title: Dynamic Mesh Claim Buffer
dynamic_mesh_land_claim_buffer.description: Chunk radius around each claim where dynamic mesh stays active.

dynamic_mesh_max_item_cache.title: Concurrent Dynamic Mesh Work Items
dynamic_mesh_max_item_cache.description: Number of mesh work items processed concurrently. Higher values use more RAM.

web_dashboard_enabled.title: Enable Web Dashboard
web_dashboard_enabled.description: Turn on the dedicated server's built-in web dashboard.

web_dashboard_url.title: Web Dashboard URL
web_dashboard_url.description: Optional full external URL for the built-in web dashboard when you place it behind a reverse proxy instead of sharing the host IP and dashboard port directly.

enable_map_rendering.title: Render Dashboard Map Tiles
enable_map_rendering.description: Enable the dedicated server's native map-tile rendering for its built-in Web Dashboard.

telnet_enabled.title: Enable Telnet
telnet_enabled.description: Written to serverconfig.xml as TelnetEnabled; when true the dedicated server opens Telnet for LanGame player and admin commands.

telnet_password.title: Telnet Password
telnet_password.description: Written to serverconfig.xml as TelnetPassword; the dedicated server reads it for authenticated Telnet player and admin commands.

telnet_failed_login_limit.title: Telnet Failed Login Limit
telnet_failed_login_limit.description: Number of wrong passwords allowed from one remote client before the server blocks that client from telnet.

telnet_failed_logins_blocktime.title: Telnet Block Time (Seconds)
telnet_failed_logins_blocktime.description: How long the native telnet block lasts after a client reaches the failed-login limit.

terminal_window_enabled.title: Keep Terminal Window
terminal_window_enabled.description: Keep the native dedicated-server terminal window visible. Leave this off to keep LanGame as the only operator-facing console surface.

eac_enabled.title: Easy Anti-Cheat
eac_enabled.description: Enable Easy Anti-Cheat for the server.

hide_command_execution_log.title: Hide Command Execution Log
hide_command_execution_log.description: Controls how aggressively command execution is hidden from logs and remote clients.

twitch_server_permission.title: Twitch Server Permission
twitch_server_permission.description: Required 7DTD permission level to use Twitch integration on the server.

twitch_blood_moon_allowed.title: Allow Twitch During Blood Moon
twitch_blood_moon_allowed.description: Allow Twitch-triggered actions during blood moon. This can increase server load by spawning more zombies.
